2527-4076-4279-4549-6772.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-6772.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3967-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
3967-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

512-1719-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
512-1719-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1719-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4694-5330-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5330-6258-7306.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

728-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
728-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
728-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1429-3545-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1477-2034-2073-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Elven Bow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

4050-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
4050-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4460-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4460-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

250-779-1479-4693-4862.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-4862.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

640-2173-2921-5010.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

3000-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing Squee, the Squirrel and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1477-2018-4053.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing it.
When Extruder dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Extruder from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

252-2079-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-2079-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

4444-4798-6462.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4444-4798-6462.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers. Holding priority, activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness
without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

478-539-3990--111.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2999-3097-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-997-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-997-5434.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2178-2557-4214-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Mycon has at least three spore counters on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vorel of the Hull Clade.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2557-4214-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {G}{U}.
When the Saporlings die, Vorel of the Hull Clade triggers twice, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Utopia Mycon has four or more spore counters on it to begin the combo, this combo nets infinite spore counters on Utopia Mycon, which you may remove for infinite Saproling tokens and/or colored mana, or target another creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.

225-1021-1315-1556.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1021-1315-1556.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

579-3525-3793-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
579-3525-3793-5115.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding six {C}.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-1532-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three Islands.
An opponent cannot block and kill Zethi.
249-1532-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {3}{W} to cast a copy of Faith's Reward.
Resolve the copy of Faith's Reward, returning all permanent cards that were put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

2580-3707-5141.description:
Cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Activate Lethal Vapors an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}: until your next turn your life total can't change and you have protection from everything.
Allow all the activated abilities from Lethal Vapors to resolve, skipping an arbitrarily large number of turns.

2034-2773-5003-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding {C}{C}.
Workhorse dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Workhorse from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Workhorse enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 4 damages to any target.
Repeat.

614-1518-1987-5116.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
614-1518-1987-5116.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
